findings.text: non-blocking: ROADMAP_TOOL_VIEWS is a second declaration of the roadmap view vocabulary that reckon/mcp_views.py:3552 already owns (roadmap_view raises the invalid_view refusal for anything outside summary/detail/raw, and reckon/mcp.py:1862 and 1885 restate it as a Literal), so the set now has five copies and the pre-flight at reckon/mcp.py:2101 can drift out of step with the read it guards: add a fourth roadmap view to mcp_views and _roadmap_tool refuses a view the read serves, which is the same false-refusal defect the blocking finding f48bcc81218 raised for the live vocabulary and that this run repaired by giving that vocabulary one owner at reckon/crew/query.py:274. No drift exists at the reviewed head — all copies name the same three views — so this does not hold the node, but the repair is the one already applied once in this run: declare the set in its owner and import it.

non-blocking: this case calls mcp._read_plan_tool(project="fixture", view="RAW") with no monkeypatch, so unlike every other case in the file it runs against the host's real project registry instead of the storage stub (compare _stubbed at tests/test_a_malformed_request_is_refused_before_storage.py:63, installed by every refusal case). The assertion is only that the error is not invalid_view, so it stays green whatever the read answers, but the case reads state outside the repository under test and its runtime depends on the machine's mounts rather than on the code.
